images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Co-op kitchen-chaos style laundromat game, fixed three-quarter top-down camera looking down about 55 degrees at the whole shop floor like Overcooked; teal and white checkered tile floor, cozy neon night lighting. Four small chubby staff characters with round heads, caps and aprons in four player colors (pink, cyan, yellow, lime), each with a small colored ring under their feet and a name tag P1-P4, working at different stations: on the left a service counter with a big open hatch where a huge friendly orange lava-giant monster rests its chin and hands over a giant pink knitted scarf, a slime blob and a three-eyed purple bat monster queue behind it; a sorting table with three labeled bins (털, 비늘, 니트); a stain bench with three spray bottles (cyan, green, violet) where the yellow worker sprays a glowing orange lava stain; a row of three enormous round-door washing machines with foam behind the glass, one showing a temperature tag '40°'; two tumble dryers with orange progress rings; a folding table with neatly folded giant monster clothes and an exit chute. Clothes baskets carried overhead. Top HUD: a row of four paper order tickets with monster portraits, garment icons, stain icons and shrinking timer bars; top right '2일차 19:42', '팁 1,240', '단골 호감' hearts. One ticket reads '부글이 · 니트 목도리 · 30° 이하'. Small warning tag above dryer: '수축 위험 18%'. Stylized chunky 3D-like cartoon render, soft shadows, mint, hot pink and warm orange, bubbles floating.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same laundromat from exactly the same three-quarter top-down camera, now in emergency: red rotating alarm light washes the tiles, foam spilling everywhere. The huge orange lava-giant monster has burst halfway through the service counter hatch, counter cracked, glowing lava veins, furious amber eyes, steam from its nostrils; around its enormous neck is a comically tiny shrunken pink knitted scarf, choking it. Clothes, socks and baskets fly through the air, a washing machine tipped over. The four small chubby staff in pink, cyan, yellow and lime aprons scramble: the pink one runs toward the monster holding a steaming iron, the cyan one pulls the scarf with both hands, the yellow one hides behind a dryer, the lime one carries a giant cookie as a peace offering. Big comic text banner at top center: '부글이 폭주!'. A thick striped rage bar at top labeled '분노 86'. Tag near scarf: '목도리 수축 −38%'. Bottom center prompt: '다리미로 늘려라! 6.2초'. Small side panel: '원인: 건조기 고온 70°'. Stylized chunky 3D-like cartoon render, crimson and magenta alarm light with hot pink highlights, slight camera shake feel, slapstick comedy mood.
